$comment: Generated from RegradeRecord in src/history/types.ts by `pnpm schema:update`; don't edit. What one reeval regrade changed in a run: <run>/regrades/<id>.json in the history folder, which readers apply.
title: RegradeRecord

CostUsd.description: A dollar figure and where it came from.

basis.description: `reported`: what the harness (Claude Code, pi) or the gateway (OpenRouter) said it cost; `estimated`: the tokens at list prices, which leave out discounts, and long-prompt rates where a model call's own tokens, or the price's tiers, aren't known.

source.description: Who reported it (`claude-code`, `pi`, `openrouter`, `fake`), or the prices it was estimated at (`models.dev 2026-11-05`, a `REEVAL_PRICES` file); several, joined with `, `, in a sum.

GradeFingerprint.description: What makes two grades of the same trial comparable: equal digests, the same grade.

code.description: sha256 of the grader's name, its `files` and its `grade` function, with the local modules of the file it's defined in; for a judge grader, of its name, question, answers, inputs and models.

data.description: sha256 of the `data` files' content; unset without `data`.

image.description: sha256 of the `env` sandbox's recipe, its egress and the id of the image it ran; unset without `env`.

reference.description: sha256 of a judge grader's reference, by each file's content; unset without one.

version.description: A built-in's code version, which reeval bumps when what it grades changes.

GradeReads.description: The trial's observations, captures and kept files a grader read, by content hash.

GradeRecord.description: One grader's result on a trial, from a grader in the eval's `graders`.

error.description: Why it has no grade: `grade` threw or timed out, or its grade or score wasn't valid.

grade.description: What `grade` returned, masked; unset when the grader errored.

grader.description: The grader's name, unique in its eval: a built-in's is `<kind>:<main argument>` unless it's given one.

group.description: Every name of the `defineGraders` group whose one `grade` call this came from.

judge.description: A judge grader's call to each model, and its reference; unset for any other.

kind.description: What the grader is: `code` runs its `grade` function on the host, `judge` asks its judge, `builtin` is one of `reeval/graders`' other graders.

reads.description: What the grader read from the trial, by content hash, in first-read order.

required.description: Whether a score under 1 (or an error) makes the trial's score 0.

score.description: In [0, 1]: `score(grade)`, or 1 or 0 for a boolean grade, or 0 when the grader errored; null for a grade that has no score, which is recorded only.

scoreDigest.description: sha256 of the `score` function and the local modules of the file it's defined in; unset without one.

weight.description: Its share of the trial's score; 0 records only.

JudgeGrade.description: What a judge grader asked: each model's answer, and the reference it showed.

calls.description: One per model, in the grader's order; unset when it errored before asking.

dropped.description: What the judge's state leaves out and why, e.g. `dist/ (3 files): build output`.

reference.description: The reference shown, by content; unset without one.

JudgeGradeCall.description: One model's answer to a judge grader.

answer.description: Yes or no, or the answer it chose.

cost.description: The call's cost: the gateway's, else its tokens at list prices; unset with neither.

costUsd.description: What the gateway says the call cost, in US dollars; unset when it names none.

gateway.description: The gateway from the config's `gateway` list the call went through; unset without one.

probability.description: The model's probability of yes, or of the answer it chose, when it gives one.

resolvedModel.description: The model id the provider says served the call, when it reports one.

retries.description: Transient provider errors retried on the way to the answer.

usage.description: The call's tokens, when the provider reported them.

JudgeRetry.description: One failed judge try that was retried, and the backoff before the next.

PrepareFailureRecord.description: The sandbox a trial needed that couldn't be prepared before the run, on each trial that needed it: its provider's stage (Docker's `image`, `from`, `dockerfile`, `harness` or `install`, or `workspace` for a git workspace, whose `ref` is `repo#ref:path`), what was being made, the class (`config`, `transient` after the retries, or `resource`), a named cause (`enospc`, `oom`), the build log, and the levels that set it.

ProviderStopRecord.description: The model provider ended a turn, not the agent: out of credit, over its quota, rate limited or overloaded, with the HTTP status of the last model call the egress gateway brokered when that call failed (`null` when it didn't, as in a stream that failed inside an HTTP 200, or none was). The trial is then an infra error, so `--retry-errors` runs it again.

RegradeAction.description: What a regrade did with one grader on one trial: `kept` it (unchanged, or not selected), `rescored` its stored grade (its score, weight or required changed), `recomputed` it (its fingerprint changed: `changed` names the parts), ran a `new` grader, left one the eval no longer has (`not-found`), kept one whose inputs the run didn't keep (`inputs-missing`, with `reason`) or kept one whose grade couldn't be had (`failed`: a judge that errored, a grader sandbox that didn't start, a timeout or an interrupt, with the error as `reason`). A code grader's own throw is `recomputed`, its grade holding the error and scoring 0 as a run's does.

RegradedTrial.description: One trial as a regrade left it.

actions.description: What happened to each grader on it.

error.description: Why it fails now: its score under the run's target; null when it passes.

grades.description: Every grade it reads with now, in the eval's order, a grade not regraded as it was. A reader takes from it only the grades its `actions` rescored, recomputed or added, over what earlier regrades left, so two regrades of different graders both hold.

key.description: The trial's `key` in the run record.

RegradeRecord.description: What one `reeval regrade` changed in one run: the trials whose grades it changed, each with its new grades, score and outcome, which readers put in place of the recorded ones. The record itself is never rewritten.

git.description: The commit the graders were read at; null outside a git repository.

graders.description: `--grader`: the only graders it ran; unset when it ran every grader that changed.

id.description: Also the file name in the run's `regrades/` folder: `<UTC time>_<random>`.

reeval.description: The reeval version that wrote it.

regradeOf.description: The id of the run it regrades.

ResourceFailureRecord.description: The sandbox ran out of a resource during the trial: `oom` is the kernel killing `kills` processes at its memory limit. The trial is then an infra error, whatever its checks said.

TokenUsage.description: The tokens one turn used, as its harness reported them. `input` excludes cache reads and writes (so the prompt was `input + cacheRead + cacheWrite`); `reasoning` is part of `output`.

TrialError.description: Why a trial failed; `prepare` when its sandbox couldn't be prepared, `resource` when it ran out of one, `provider` when the model provider stopped a turn.

turn.description: Set when an unhandled mid-turn error was reclassified as infra: the turn index and whether it looked like a config refusal or a transport failure.
